pwa_sensing_activity_detail: Whether you are still, walking, running, cycling or in a vehicle, noted by Android throughout the day.
pwa_sensing_activity_no_services: Needs Google Play services, which this phone does not have.
pwa_sensing_footer: Collected data is sent to the research server in the background. Your questionnaire answers are always sent straight away, over any connection. Leaving the study stops the collection and deletes anything not yet sent.
pwa_sensing_intro: This study collects some information from your phone to understand the moments around your questionnaires. Here you can see what is collected and whether it is working.
pwa_sensing_light_detail: How bright it is around you, measured when you open and finish a questionnaire.
pwa_sensing_light_problem: This phone has no light sensor.
pwa_sensing_motion_detail: The phone's motion sensor, from %d minutes before each questionnaire until %d minutes after it. Android shows a notification while it records.
pwa_sensing_motion_problem: This phone has no motion sensor.
pwa_sensing_net_any: Sent over any connection, Wi-Fi or mobile data.
pwa_sensing_net_wifi_only: Sent over Wi-Fi only. Connect to Wi-Fi now and then so your data reaches the research team.
pwa_sensing_net_wifi_preferred_one: Sent over Wi-Fi, to spare your mobile data. If your phone has not been on Wi-Fi for %d hour, mobile data is used.
pwa_sensing_net_wifi_preferred_other: Sent over Wi-Fi, to spare your mobile data. If your phone has not been on Wi-Fi for %d hours, mobile data is used.
pwa_sensing_usage_both: Which apps you open and when, and daily totals per app. Only app names are shared, never what you do in them.
pwa_sensing_usage_daily: How long you use each app per day and how often you unlock your phone. Only app names are shared, never what you do in them.
pwa_sensing_usage_events: Which apps you open and when the screen turns on, off and unlocks. Only app names are shared, never what you do in them.
pwa_sensing_usage_problem: Switch on "Usage access" for iEMAbot in Android's settings.

pwa_wearables_footer: Your data is collected periodically by the research server while your wearable stays connected. The server also keeps a record of when your provider reports new data (for example a new sleep session), whether or not it leads to a questionnaire. Disconnecting stops the collection; what was already collected stays with the study. To have your data removed, contact the researchers.
pwa_wearables_intro: Connect a wearable to share its health data with this study. You'll be taken to the provider's site to sign in and approve. You can disconnect at any time.
pwa_wearables_none: No wearables are available for this study.
pwa_about_credits: iEMAbot is made by the Surrey Sleep Research Centre and the UK Dementia Research Institute, and builds on ESMira, a free research platform from Karl Landsteiner University in Austria. Both are open source: anyone can read the code to see exactly how the app works.
pwa_machine_translated_note: This language was translated by a machine and has not been reviewed by people yet, so it may contain mistakes.
pwa_about_intro: iEMAbot helps researchers learn how people's feelings, sleep and daily lives change over time. Instead of one long questionnaire, it sends you short check-ins during your day, as a simple chat, so you can answer in a minute or two wherever you are.
pwa_about_no_uploads: No uploads yet. Each time you submit a questionnaire, the upload to the research server will be listed here.
